t2.thesis: An 11% pre-earnings surge driven by Uber's report prices in rideshare volume strength ahead of entry, leaving Lyft vulnerable to post-print profit-taking under a newly appointed CFO's initial guidance.
reasons: Lyft rallied ~11% on November 4 following Uber's earnings, significantly elevating the entry price baseline for the November 5 open.
Uber reported a soft profit outlook, suggesting potential industry margin or take-rate headwinds that could temper Lyft's Q4 guidance.
New CFO Michael Brous, who assumed office in late September, faces typical incentives to set a conservative forward outlook for his first earnings print.
High short float (21.7%) and low valuation (forward P/E ~8.7x) provide some downside cushion against a severe drop.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 Adjusted EBITDA guidance and whether rider growth / gross bookings surpass the upper end of Q3 guidance.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down from 0.54 to 0.49 (-0.05) because the sharp 5-day run-up (+14.7%) front-runs sector strength and sets a high bar for guidance, combined with new CFO guidance conservatism risk.

theses.expected: Q3 results meet reaffirmed targets, but Q4 guidance comes in cautious due to seasonal slowing and promotional spending, prompting a modest pullback from the elevated entry open.
theses.mechanism: Pre-print rally absorbs bullish sentiment, creating a 'sell the news' reaction as investors react to conservative Q4 EBITDA guidance.
theses.wrong_if: Lyft raises full-year targets aggressively and announces accelerating market share gains, sparking a violent short squeeze on its 21.7% short float.

theses.expected: Market continues momentum from peer rally if Lyft delivers clean EBITDA beat and reaffirms strong cash generation.
theses.mechanism: Heavy short interest forces systematic covering at the market open following healthy operational metrics.
theses.wrong_if: Take-rates or driver incentive costs contract margins more than anticipated.

theses.expected: Guidance lands exactly in line, but stock trades flat to down after the large 11% sector move earlier in the week.
theses.mechanism: Implied volatility collapse and lack of fresh positive catalyst trigger exit-session consolidation.
theses.wrong_if: Management announces an accelerated share repurchase program or unexpected capital return with free cash flow.
